name: ctx-cache-generation-idle
about: 空闲回收与提示缓存代际：gateway.idleSessionTimeoutMinutes=0.02（1.2 秒）、idleSweepIntervalSeconds=0.2（createLocalGateway.ts:827-831 → SessionRouter.ts:471-485）。连着的几轮间隔 0.3 秒，代际递增；空闲 2.5 秒后会话被逐出，下一轮重新组装，代际回到 1。模型一律回 400。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: anth/claude-bbx
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    anth:
      protocol: anthropic
      url: {MOCK}
      apiKey: bbx-anthropic-key
      retry:
        baseDelayMs: 1
        maxDelayMs: 1
        jitter: 0
      models:
        claude-bbx:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
gateway:
  idleSessionTimeoutMinutes: 0.02
  idleSweepIntervalSeconds: 0.2
